title: Aloe vera tea for medicinal use
intro: Aloe vera tea is a herbal preparation made by steeping the gel-like pulp of the aloe vera plant in hot water. It is commonly used in herbalism for its soothing and digestive properties. This tea is believed to help with mild digestive issues, such as constipation, and may support skin health due to its anti-inflammatory effects. It is also used to alleviate symptoms of inflammation and promote overall gut wellness. In traditional medicine, aloe vera tea has been valued for its potential to detoxify the body and enhance immune function.
